cadenceBasis.observed: gtfs-data.jp: the current file was published 2026-10-22 and is valid 2026-10-22 to 2027-10-21 (read 2026-11-21). The bundle holds a 14-day window (WINDOW_DAYS), so it is rebuilt every three days: the window never has fewer than 11 days left, and a date beyond it is refused (js/transit-raptor.js coverage)
cadenceBasis.expires: if the publisher moves to a different schedule, or WINDOW_DAYS changes

autoRefresh: one feed-API request (api.gtfs-data.jp) and one archive download, no key; the feed licence is re-read and the build refuses any change from CC0 1.0; the archive must contain a calendar covering a day from today on, and nothing is written when any of that fails
